# @vllnt/convex-memberships

> Auth-agnostic membership and relationship graph (ReBAC tuples), as a Convex component

`@vllnt/convex-memberships` is a publishable Convex component. It targets `convex@^1.45.0`.
It stores one sandboxed table - `memberships`, holding flat ReBAC edges `(memberRef, resourceRef, relation)` with an opaque, host-classified `memberKind` (default `"user"`) and an optional opaque `status`. It lists a resource's members and a member's resources with bounded pagination (`numItems` 1 through 1000 and `maximumRowsRead` capped at 1000; invalid numeric options throw `INVALID_PAGE_SIZE`), checks a membership (bounded `by_tuple` prefix lookup), changes a relation, and exposes full docs (`createdAt`, `status`) via `documents`. Edges are FLAT - no transitive expansion (`expandMembers` / `resolve` is vNext). The host owns identity, auth, and the rich entity; the component owns only the edges. `memberRef`, `resourceRef`, `relation`, `memberKind`, and `status` are opaque host strings the component never inspects. `add` is tuple-idempotent and patches `memberKind`/`status` on re-add. `setRelation` requires the source edge to exist before applying a same-relation no-op. The unscoped `isMember` (no `relation`) returns true for any stored relation — do not use it as an authz gate without enumerating acceptable relations.

Entry points: `@vllnt/convex-memberships` (the `Memberships` client and its types), `/convex.config` (the component definition for `app.use`), `/react` (optional hooks `useIsMember`, `useMembers`, `useListMembers`), `/test` (`register` for `convex-test`).

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the npm package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-memberships/docs/` and match the installed version. Read them before writing code against this package. The TypeScript sources are in `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-memberships/src/`.
